# JSON dependency

JSON for Modern C++ 3.11.3, Niels Lohmann and contributors.

- Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3
- File: single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp, preserved as nlohmann/json.hpp.
- License: nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT.
- SHA-256: 9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6.

The checksum matches the official release metadata. A vendored header makes
native builds reproducible and keeps parser implementation out of public types.
